events.title: Beta 0.8: a smoother swamp
events.summary: Hi everyone!A new update for the Froggous Grove demo. Your saves are kept: you pick up your swamp right where you left it.Smoother and prettierThe game runs up to twice as smoothly in a well-filled swamp.No more small freezes at sunrise and sunset.A new matte look: decorations, plants and clothes no longer shine like plastic. Glass keeps its reflections.When the camera goes into a big tree, the leaves fade away instead of hiding everything.Decorate up highShift + Enlarge now \lifts\ a decoration

events.title: Beta 0.7: a swamp you can hear
events.summary: Hi everyone!A new update for the Froggous Grove demo. Your saves are kept: you pick up your swamp right where you left it.A brand new soundscapeThe swamp now has its own living soundscape: wind, rain, a stream, drips in the cave, rustling grass...The healthier your swamp, the more birds come back to sing. events.title: Beta 0.6: a swamp that lives day and night
events.summary: Hello everyone!A big day of work on the Froggous Grove demo: here is everything that changes. Your saves are kept, you pick up your swamp right where you left it.Animals sleepAt night, frogs look for a free lily pad to sleep on. No lily pad big enough, or already taken? They sleep on the ground... and they let you know.Frogs close their eyes while sleeping, and " ZzZz " float above every sleeping animal. Lily pads can be enlarged (up to 2.5 times) to fit the biggest frogs.Needs for every animalE
